# Compliance Check and Risk Monitoring Directives

This document outlines key directives for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Optimize the standard update process for regulatory changes.
*   Monitor legal risks on a quarterly basis.
*   Investigate Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection findings based on audit reports.
*   Optimize the management of legal risks quarterly.
*   Update the standard for regulatory changes.
